messages:
ajay: Heads-up — wanted to kick off a short sync on SLA-driven pin policy tradeoffs. We have 3 enterprise customers asking to keep pinned models for GA with 99.9 latency SLO. Can we discuss options?
katy: Thanks Ajay. TL;DR: scope choices are 1) longer pin TTLs (costly), 2) fast migration path + credits, 3) dedicated capacity + SLA. Need engineering cost estimates.
samir: +1. From infra perspective, option 3 needs reserved GPU pools; estimate 2-4 weeks with current capacity planning. Option 1 is easiest but blows unit economics.
lina: For model behavior: pinned older versions can cause quality regression risk if we roll newer safety patches. Suggest pin TTL with active canary checks.
ajay: Good point Lina. Customers want "no surprise" behavior. How about pin TTL 90 days + auto-canary every 7 days? If canary fails auto-rollback to newer model? 
katy: That might be acceptable to customers if we include a "migration window" and credits. Need wording for contracts.
samir: Implementation notes:
```yaml
pin_policy:
  type: time-limited
  ttl_days: 90
  canary_interval_days: 7
  auto_escalate: true
  fallback: latest_compatible
```
samir: Will need routing changes (fast path to dedicated GPUs) and a rollout job to remap tenants.
product-bot: Note: added 'sla-pin-policy-draft' to the roadmap board and assigned to @katy and @samir :spiral_calendar: 
maria: Quick Q: For customers with legal restrictions, can we offer indefinite pin with audit logs (Private deployments)?
lina: Yes, but only for Private; Hosted customers should be subject to TTL unless contractual exception. Also quantization/security patches may require a forced migration.
ajay: Contract ask: customer A wants pinned v1.3 until 2027-01-01. Can we do exception path? If so what's the approval flow?
katy: Proposal: exceptions go through Product+Security signoff + legal. We add 'pin-exception' CFR ticket and a 3rd-party review for critical patches.
samir: Ops checklist for exception:
- reserve capacity tag
- create canary build
- create rollback playbook
- billing/credit note
katy: Can we estimate cost delta for 90d TTL vs indefinite? If it's >20% we propose migration credits to customers.
maria: That seems fair. Also need customer-facing doc explaining tradeoffs and the "what we do if a security patch conflicts".
ajay: Next steps: samir to prototype routing changes and cost estimate by EOW, katy to draft exception flow & customer comms, lina to define canary metrics. Anyone object?
lina: No objections.
samir: On it, will post updates in this thread.
katy: I'll draft comms and share with legal.
ajay: Thanks all. We'll sync next Wed 11am PST. :calendar:
